context: A doctor and patient discuss a skin rash from last night
purpose: Teach: 昨夜/皮膚/棒/手前/即/文法/留学生/毒

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: こんにちは、メイさん。昨夜から皮膚に発疹が出たとカルテにありますね。
lines.en: Hello Mei. The chart says a rash appeared on your skin from last night.
lines.style: Calm professional greeting with a measured clinical tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: はい、昨夜遅くに急に痒くなって…うちの手前にある薬局で軟膏を買ったんですけど、全然効かなくて。
lines.en: Yes, late last night it suddenly itched, and the ointment I bought at the pharmacy just in front of my place didn't work at all.
lines.style: Worried softly anxious patient voice with gentle pleading undertone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: なるほど。腕に棒状の赤い線が走っていますね。これは典型的な接触性皮膚炎の症状です。
lines.en: I see. There's a rod-shaped red line running along your arm — this is a typical contact dermatitis symptom.
lines.style: Focused clinical observation delivered in steady reassuring physician cadence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 接触…? あ、もしかして庭の植物かも。同居してる留学生の友達が、新しい鉢植えを持ち込んだんです。
lines.en: Contact…? Oh, maybe it's a garden plant — the exchange student friend living with me brought in new potted plants.
lines.style: Realisation dawning gently with light embarrassed self-discovery tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: それでしょう。植物の中には毒性のある成分を含むものもあるので、葉には触れないようにしてください。
lines.en: That's likely it. Some plants contain toxic components, so please avoid touching the leaves.
lines.style: Firm authoritative medical instruction with caring underlying warmth throughout.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わかりました。友達はまだ日本語の文法に慣れてなくて、ラベルが読めないから私が世話してたんです…
lines.en: Understood. My friend isn't used to Japanese grammar yet and can't read the labels, so I'd been caring for them…
lines.style: Sheepish confessional explanation with mildly apologetic softness throughout.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: では強めのステロイド軟膏を出しますね。一週間で治らなければ、即、再診にいらしてください。
lines.en: Then I'll prescribe a stronger steroid ointment. If it doesn't heal in a week, please come back for a follow-up right away.
lines.style: Reassuring closing instruction delivered with kind professional decisiveness throughout.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、先生。本当に助かりました。
lines.en: Thank you so much, doctor. You've really been a lifesaver.
lines.style: Relieved heartfelt gratitude with soft warm sincere closing tone.
